definitions.gloss: popular song; hit song of an era
definitions.explanation: A song that is widely popular at a particular time, especially the popular songs of earlier decades. Somewhat dated; the word evokes the popular music of the past rather than current pop.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}の{流行歌|りゅうこうか}を{口|くち}ずさんだ。
examples.english: I hummed an old popular song.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{若|わか}いころの{流行歌|りゅうこうか}をよく{歌|うた}う。
examples.english: My mother often sings the popular songs of her youth.

examples.japanese: その{曲|きょく}は{戦後|せんご}の{流行歌|りゅうこうか}として{多|おお}くの{人|ひと}に{愛|あい}された。
examples.english: That song was loved by many as a popular song of the postwar period.

notes:
Compound of {流行|りゅうこう} (being in vogue) + {歌|か／うた} (song). Also read はやりうた, with the same meaning and a slightly more colloquial feel.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昔|むかし}の{流行歌|りゅうこうか}: an old popular song
- {流行歌|りゅうこうか}を{歌|うた}う: to sing a popular song

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {歌謡曲|かようきょく}: popular song — a genre label for mainstream Japanese pop of the mid-20th century
- ヒット{曲|きょく}: hit song — modern, neutral term for any currently or recently popular song
